english.title: Fail to move a vehicle - terrorism
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[driver]_
(B)_[person in charge]_

of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which had been permitted to remain at rest, in contravention of a prohibition or restriction imposed under section 48 of the Terrorism Act 2000, failed to move the vehicle when ordered to do so by a constable in uniform
english.legislation: Contrary to section 51(2) and (6) of the Terrorism Act 2000.
